description: Trigger evals for devrites-api-interface — designing stable API/interface contracts before implementation (REST/GraphQL endpoints, module boundaries, type contracts, FE/BE splits); must NOT fire for internal helpers, post-ship review, or sibling build/review/polish/prove/debug/tdd/prototype work.

queries.text: Design the API for this feature before we start coding.
queries.rationale: Canonical "design the API" trigger from the description.

queries.text: Let's contract this out so the frontend and backend aren't blocked on each other.
queries.rationale: "Contract this out" + unblock-both-sides framing.

queries.text: Split the frontend and backend for this slice.
queries.rationale: Direct FE/BE split trigger phrase.

queries.text: This slice crosses the FE/BE boundary — nail down the interface first.
queries.rationale: A slice crossing a boundary is exactly contract-first territory.

queries.text: Define the REST endpoints: request/response shape, status codes, and error bodies.
queries.rationale: Shape + status/errors of REST endpoints is the contract surface.

queries.text: Design the GraphQL schema and types before implementation.
queries.rationale: GraphQL contract design ahead of build.

queries.text: What should the module boundary between the parser and the renderer look like?
queries.rationale: Module/module boundary contract.

queries.text: Lock the type contract between these two services before either side builds.
queries.rationale: Service/service type contract, stabilized up front.

queries.text: We need a stable interface here so both sides can build against a mock in parallel.
queries.rationale: Stable interface enabling the parallel split is the skill's purpose.

queries.text: Is this a breaking change to the existing endpoint's response shape?
queries.rationale: Versioning/compat of an existing contract is a contract decision.

queries.text: Pin down the function signature and error semantics for this public interface.
queries.rationale: Signature + error semantics of a public interface.

queries.text: Two teams are about to build against each other — agree the request/response and error codes up front so neither blocks.
queries.rationale: Oblique but clear: cross-boundary contract before parallel work.

queries.text: Write the internal helper that formats dates for this module.
queries.rationale: Internal helper, not a cross-boundary contract — /rite-build owns it (explicit Not-for).

queries.text: Review the interface of this already-shipped endpoint.
queries.rationale: Post-ship interface review is /rite-review (the explicit Not-for boundary).

queries.text: Polish the UI before review.
queries.rationale: Pre-review polish is /rite-polish, not contract design.

queries.text: Prove the new endpoint works end-to-end with the full test suite.
queries.rationale: Full end-to-end proof is /rite-prove.

queries.text: The endpoint is returning 500s — figure out why it's broken.
queries.rationale: Debugging a failure belongs to diagnose / devrites-debug-recovery.

queries.text: Code-review my diff for correctness bugs and cleanups.
queries.rationale: Diff-level review is the bundled code-review skill.

queries.text: Red-green-refactor the endpoint: failing test first, then implement.
queries.rationale: Test-first implementation is the tdd skill.

queries.text: Throwaway prototype a couple of response shapes so I can play with them.
queries.rationale: Disposable exploration is the prototype skill, not a stable contract.
